participants.label: External agent
participants.sublabel: support agent, talks to the user
participants.note: owns the ticket: acknowledges, relays, answers, monitors, closes

participants.label: Internal agent
participants.sublabel: runs the RCA, works with the team
participants.note: never talks to the user; everything to the user goes through the external agent

participants.label: Team
participants.note: sees the RCA report and can @tag the internal agent

messages.label: Thank you, we are on it
messages.note: sent at once, before any analysis

messages.label: request details
messages.note: the request with everything attached to it

messages.label: need more info from the user?
messages.note: the one question after each RCA run. Yes: m6 to m10. No (RCA is clear): go to m11

messages.label: info request
messages.note: only when more info is needed

messages.label: asks the user for the info
/rca again, until clear
messages.note: repeat m4 to m9 every iteration until the RCA is clear

messages.label: RCA report
messages.note: shown in the internal conversation once the RCA is clear

messages.label: @agent: more details?
messages.note: optional: the team tags the agent in the conversation itself

messages.label: user's reaction
messages.note: the external agent keeps watching the ticket after the response

messages.label: close the internal ticket
messages.note: optional, after the user's ticket is closed
